title: Euphoria
plot_overview: After a young woman is raped by a group of young men from powerful families, she and her family seek justice. The story explores the emotional impact of the assault and the difficult path toward accountability, taking a serious, grounded approach to a sensitive subject.
will_you_like_this: You may appreciate this serious, emotionally intense story if you value grounded drama and meaningful themes; Not for you if you prefer light entertainment or want a less distressing subject.
review_summary: Pros: emotionally powerful; grounded and serious; meaningful message | Cons: some rushed pacing; leaves issues unexplored; difficult subject matter
